tasks.name: 추적 나침반 A — 원형
tasks.subject: 한계선의 잔불 추격
tasks.description: 두꺼운 금빛 원형 테두리와 붉은 불씨 모양 지시침
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, low-resolution pixel-art relic design.
Asset: ONE single 32x32 inventory relic for a fantasy 2D roguelike, one of the Crimson Limit staff's exclusive relics.
Input image 1 is a WEAPON DESIGN reference only. Borrow the distinctive red core cradled by stout gold fork/claw ornaments from the staff head; do not depict the staff shaft or copy the whole weapon.
Input image 2 is the approved PIXEL STYLE and PALETTE reference, five existing fire relics. Match their chunky stepped contours, broad contiguous flat colors, minimal interior detail, deliberate coarse pixel grid and strong small-size readability. Do not reproduce their subjects.
Shared identity: a vivid RED central magical component held by thick GOLD casing with two short blunt gold horn/claw tips near its upper edge, visually related to the reference staff head. A compact tangible ancient magical artifact. Keep all parts stout and substantial. No long stalks, thin wires, hanging chains, micro-engraving, detached sparks or mist.
Intended logical canvas EXACTLY 32x32, with uniform TWO logical pixel dark charcoal OUTER outline. Every visible pixel including outline must lie within x=2..29 and y=2..29: at least TWO fully transparent pixels on ALL FOUR sides. Use natural proportions, never stretch. Enlarge only as a regular grid of equal square logical pixels.
Use ONLY SIX opaque colors TOTAL, all from the approved palette: #363232 charcoal outline and recessed cavities; #A75064 muted red shadow; #E55C5C red core; #E09656 orange/gold shadow; #EECF5A yellow/gold lit casing; #F1E9D4 warm cream tiny highlight. Use all six in purposeful solid clusters. Gold casing and red center dominate. Cream limited to a small highlight, no large white gloss.
Real transparent background. Exactly ONE isolated centered icon, NO sheet or other variant, no labels, numbers, letters, compass letters, runes, frame, tile, backdrop or ground.
No gradients, dithering, tiny texture pixels, noise, glossy rendering, antialiasing, blur, cast shadows, external glow, scene lighting or photo style. Simplify for true 32x32, two or three clear planes maximum.

SUBJECT: EMBER-TRACKING MAGIC COMPASS, ROUND VARIANT A.
A small FLAT, front-facing round compass disk, with a very thick GOLD circular bezel and dark charcoal recessed dial. Two short solid gold claw tips rise from its upper-left and upper-right shoulders, echoing the weapon head. Centered on the dial is ONE stout RED ember-shaped pointer/lozenge pointing toward the upper right, wide enough to be readable, with a muted-red underside and a tiny cream hot center. The pointer is a solid directional shape, not a hair-thin needle. One or two small simple gold index blocks on the dial can suggest navigation, but no letters or dense ticks. The casing is mostly yellow/gold and orange, with a small muted-red bottom edge for depth. A thick solid lower rim, no handle or hanging loop. Make the overall object a broad readable disk, clearly a direction-finding relic, not a floating fireball or a gold coin with a face.

SUBJECT: EMBER-TRACKING MAGIC COMPASS, DIAMOND VARIANT B.
A compact FLAT diamond-shaped compass body with four broad chamfered corners and a thick GOLD angular bezel. It must have a clearly different square/diamond silhouette from a round compass. Two small blunt gold fork tips at the upper corners echo the weapon head; keep them integrated into the solid outer body. Inside the dark charcoal diamond recess sits a single large RED flame-shaped directional pointer aimed upward, with a pointed upper end, a broad rounded lower end, a muted-red side and one small cream center highlight. The casing has a yellow/gold front and one broad orange lower-right side plane; keep it almost front-facing and relatively flat. No cord, loop, pendulum chain, long lower tail or spear blade. A tangible magical direction-finding instrument with a thick chunky outline, not a shield, badge with text or a jewel necklace.

SUBJECT: SEALED LAVA POWER CORE, RING VARIANT A.
A compact THREE-DIMENSIONAL RED SPHERE held securely by thick GOLD sealing hoops, seen in a simple three-quarter view. The red molten globe is solid and round, not a flat circle: broad red front, one simple muted-red lower-right shade plane, a small orange hot area and a tiny cream highlight. A thick gold EQUATORIAL BAND wraps across the lower third of the orb, and two stout gold side claws curve upward to cradle its shoulders, ending in short blunt tips near the top, like the referenced staff head. Keep a large RED center exposed, with enough simple ring overlap to show depth. The structure forms one chunky ball-like relic, no pedestal or dangling parts. Gold bands must be visibly thick, not thin orbit lines, and no little extra moons or sparks. Distinctly spherical and volumetric, rather than a compass disk, planet Saturn, flat seal or heart.
